content.short: Pine Loans is a decentralized NFT-backed borrowing and lending protocol.
content.description: Pine Loans enables users to acquire NFTs by financing the purchase with mortgage-like terms through a buy now, pay later framework. NFT owners can secure loans backed by collateral against more than 30 NFT collections, while the protocol also supports the traditional, permissionless model of borrowing and lending. Importantly, owners maintain access to the full utilities and functionality of their NFTs even as those assets are pledged as collateral, ensuring usability remains uninterrupted during finance arrangements.
